title: Cannot disable preemptive restart
symptom: xDrip attempts to preemptively restart the sensor on day 9 despite the user wanting to disable it. The preemptive restart option checkbox is hidden, and the user cannot disable it through the UI.
cause: The preemptive restart option is hidden because the transmitter serial begins with 8H and is too new, but the setting ob1_g5_preemptive_restart is still true from a previous transmitter.
fix: Manually edit the exported settings XML to set ob1_g5_preemptive_restart to false, or enter a made-up 80 serial number to get the option back in the UI and disable it.
evidence_quote: I believe I've manually changed it by editing the settings XML. I suppose I could also have just entered a made up 80 serial number to get the option back in the UI to allow me to disable it in the regular way...
